story_text:
## Meet LEDABLE
## Why LEDABLE?
You pick up your phone to check one thing. Then you see a message. Then a headline. Then another notification. Before you know it, a quick check has turned into five minutes of scrolling.
## Features & Apps
LEDABLE is made to sit quietly in the background
Put it on your desk, shelf, nightstand, kitchen counter, or workspace.
No unlocking your phone, opening another app, or getting pulled away from what you were doing.
When you need an update, just look over.
LEDABLE comes with more than 50 ready-to-use apps, so you can start with the things you already check every day.
See the forecast before you leave. Keep an eye on a game while you work. Watch a countdown get closer. Follow the market without keeping another tab open. See your next calendar event before it sneaks up on you.
## Make It Yours
You do not need to know how to code to use LEDABLE.
Start with 50+ ready-to-use apps and choose the ones you like.
Want to build something new? LEDABLE also offers a fully open toolchain for developing custom apps.
Build your own apps. Try new ideas. Share what you make with the LEDABLE community.
Choose the apps you want to see. Put them in the order you want. Pick how long each one stays on screen.
LEDABLE moves through your playlist for you.
You decide what shows up and when.
## How It Works
LEDABLE’s 64 x 32 full-color LED matrix turns live information, animation, and pixel art into something you can read from across the room.
It has the look of a retro display with the tools you use today.
Not every pixel has to be productive.
Turn LEDABLE into desk décor with static art, animated graphics, or something you created yourself. It can keep you informed during the day and give your setup more personality after hours.
LEDABLE can also become a compact companion for your PC, keeping useful system information visible without covering your game, project, or workspace.
Track CPU and GPU activity, memory use, and temperatures on a dedicated display that looks at home in a gaming or creator setup.
With LEDABLE, you can create your own apps using JavaScript, TypeScript, or Python.
Start with sample projects and templates, connect to outside APIs, and build anything from a personal tool to a completely new LEDABLE experience.
When your app is ready, upload it to the official LEDABLE App Store. Use it yourself right away, share it with others through a private link, or submit it for review to be listed publicly in the store.
The App Store will be available at launch, and LEDABLE’s own apps are already built using the same tools available to developers.
Developer tools and documentation will be available at ledable.dev.
At 156 x 87 x 18 mm and just 210 g, LEDABLE fits into the space you already have.
Its built-in stand makes the display easy to position, while the slim profile makes it simple to move from desk to shelf, kitchen to nightstand, or setup to setup.
Clean and simple. Bright and playful. Or somewhere in between.
Choose the LEDABLE that fits your desk, room, and style.
## Specs & Compatibility
LEDABLE began with a simple question: What if checking useful information did not have to pull you into another screen?
The goal became a small display that could keep everyday updates visible, feel at home in more than one room, and stay interesting through a growing library of apps and community creations.
LEDABLE has already moved from an idea to working hardware, active app experiences, and finished product photography.
Kickstarter support will help the team complete final production preparation, continue refining the software experience, and bring LEDABLE to its first community of backers.
We are working to make delivery as clear and straightforward as possible. Final shipping rates, supported regions, taxes, and duties will be finalized post-launch.
Current Estimates:
US: $10-15
Rest of the World: $20-40
Thank you for checking out LEDABLE and helping us create a simpler way to stay informed.
If you love the idea but cannot pledge today, sharing the campaign with a friend, coworker, gamer, creator, or anyone who keeps checking “just one thing” on their phone can make a real difference.
Back LEDABLE on Kickstarter and put the information you check most in a place you can see without losing your attention.
Our Partners:
The Crowdfunding Pros at Enventys Partners have been our trusted marketing expert from day 1. Their crowdfunding expertise is unmatched, guiding us from pre-launch through funding success and beyond. While our work together has focused on crowdfunding, they also specialize in bringing products to life from a napkin sketch to market. If you’re looking to take your campaign to the next level, we highly recommend working with them.

risks: LEDABLE combines custom hardware, firmware, companion software, and live data services. Moving from working units to full production can still reveal adjustments involving components, tooling, assembly, quality control, certifications, packaging, or software. Some LEDABLE apps depend on third-party data sources and services. Those providers may change their availability, access rules, or features over time. If a service changes, the team may need to update, replace, or remove the affected integration. Component availability, international freight, customs, weather, and carrier disruptions may also affect production or delivery. The team will test throughout production and communicate openly with backers if anything changes. Final specifications, app availability, colors, and delivery timing will be confirmed before production is approved.

faq.q: Do I need to know how to code?
faq.a: No. LEDABLE is planned to launch with more than 50 ready-to-use apps. Custom development is an option, not a requirement.
Planned launch apps include time, weather, calendars, countdowns, air quality, stocks, crypto, sports, news, GitHub activity, pixel art, and more.

faq.q: Can I choose which apps appear?
faq.a: Yes. Use the LEDABLE app to choose your favorites, arrange a playlist, and control how and when content appears.

faq.q: Can I create my own apps or pixel art?
faq.a: Yes. LEDABLE is designed to support custom creations and a growing community ecosystem. Final developer-tool details will be shared as they are confirmed.

faq.q: Does it work as a PC companion?
faq.a: LEDABLE is planned to show PC information such as CPU, GPU, memory use, and temperatures through companion mode. Final platform requirements will be confirmed.
No, LEDABLE does not have a built-in battery and must remain plugged into a power source to operate.

faq.q: Does my phone need to stay connected?
faq.a: LEDABLE uses the mobile app for setup and control, but your phone does not need to be nearby for the display to keep running.
